high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "Dune 2." The scene depicted is set in a vast desert landscape, characterized by rolling sand dunes that stretch across the horizon. The color palette is dominated by warm hues of orange and yellow, evoking a sense of heat and aridity. In the foreground, there is a solitary figure standing on one of the sand dunes. The person appears to be wearing a flowing garment or cloak that billows slightly in the wind, suggesting movement and perhaps a sense of freedom or contemplation.
